name: PROFIT_SKYSCRAPER_OS
mission: Understand every Telegram-bound skin/template/gate; distribute KEEP across Mr_iv4 (money penthouse) → UNIQUE_g1 (countdown) → UNIQUE_gN (overflow, never delay); block TRASH; kid-simple play rules so every chat is fully usable even at 5 signals/day.
honesty: Dollar outcomes depend on platform stakes, volume, and WR — not guaranteed. This OS maximizes capture of every real ENTER/GALE window at minimum stake and keeps every chat readable and actionable.

mr_iv4.title: Mr_iv4 — MONEY PENTHOUSE
mr_iv4.job: Biggest money chat. ENTER NOW colors, gale retries, WIN/LOSS, ops.

unique_g1.title: UNIQUE_g1 — COUNTDOWN / SNIPER
unique_g1.job: Timed windows (JANELA / Sinal Retido / FLASH). Bet in the seconds.

overflow.title: UNIQUE_g2…gN — OVERFLOW
overflow.job: Only when Mr_iv4 or g1 is too busy. Same rules. Never wait.

play_rules.when: ENTER NOW / APOSTE AGORA / ENTRE AGORA + color (🔴/🔵)
play_rules.do: Bet the MINIMUM on that color NOW.
play_rules.stop: Wait for WIN / LOSS / gale card for this signal.

play_rules.do: Same: minimum bet on the color before the seconds hit 0.
play_rules.stop: If it says RODADA JÁ PASSOU / DO NOT BET — skip.

play_rules.when: GALE / RETENTATIVA / Entre novamente / AGUARDANDO G1
play_rules.do: Same color, MINIMUM bet again (G1). Then G2 only if the card says so.
play_rules.stop: Never invent G3+ unless the chat posts it.

play_rules.do: Round over. Bank the win. Wait for next ENTER.
play_rules.stop: Do not re-bet the same round.
Do not chase with your own gales.

play_rules.when: DO NOT BET / NÃO APOSTE / RODADA PASSOU / EXPIROU / G2 MISS

play_rules.do: Read. Do not bet from ops alone.
play_rules.stop: Bet only from ENTER / JANELA / GALE cards.

stake_policy.rule: Always the platform minimum unit. Volume of correct windows > size of bet.
stake_policy.gale_ladder: G0 = 1u, G1 = 1u (same min), G2 = 1u only if card says enter G2.
stake_policy.never: Never raise stake to 'recover'. Never bet without a card.
stake_policy.worst_case_5_signals: Even if a chat only posts 5 ENTER days: play all 5 with min stake + official gales. Skip DO-NOT-BET. That chat is still fully used.

RESULT.user: Stop round on WIN/LOSS; follow gale if posted

ROOM_RELAY.user: Do not bet from raw relay alone
